correctness.rationale: The exact scan equations distinguish the initial site, interior sites and final site. Three necessary pattern/boundary tests follow by Boolean selection and backward propagation. The predecessor defined by x_i=y_(i-1) OR y_i on interior coordinates and three endpoint cases verifies every admissible target. A four-pair-state automaton traces cyclic `101` avoiders, and two disjoint boundary-exclusion matrix entries yield the exact rational generating function. Symbolic determinant, recurrence, enumerator and constructed predecessors have been independently checked by the included scripts (exhaustive through n=18). The all-n step is the constructive Boolean proof and transfer identity, not finite enumeration.

value.rationale: Exact one-step reachability under deterministic sequential updating is a natural fundamental invariant of a classical automaton. The theorem offers a full constructive inverse for the reachable output language, determines exact Garden-of-Eden populations and spectral entropy for every ring size, and isolates a genuine boundary effect absent from simultaneous traffic dynamics. It is not a finite enumeration or an immediate renaming of a synchronous theorem.
